options.name: ca_config
options.description: The path to the certificate authority configuration file on the host.

options.name: ca_url
options.description: URI of the targeted Step Certificate Authority. Used if the module is run in online mode (default) and the hosts C(step-cli) is not configured to trust the CA.

options.name: cert
options.description: The path to the cert that should be revoked. Can be let empty if I(serial_number) is defined.

options.name: key
options.description: The path to the key corresponding to the cert that should be revoked. Can be let empty if I(serial_number) is defined.

options.name: offline
options.description: Don't contact the CA. Offline mode uses the configuration, certificates, and keys created with step ca init, but can accept a different configuration file using the I(ca_config) flag.

options.name: reason
options.description: The string representing the reason for which the cert is being revoked.

options.name: reason_code
options.description: The reasonCode specifies the reason for revocation - chose from a list of common revocation reasons. If unset, the default is Unspecified. See https://smallstep.com/docs/step-cli/reference/ca/revoke for more details

options.name: root
options.description: The path to the PEM file used as the root certificate authority. Used if the module is run in online mode (default) and the hosts C(step-cli) is not configured to trust the CA.

options.name: serial_number
options.description: The serial number of the certificate that should be revoked. Can be left blank when using I(cert) and I(key) params for revocation over mTLS.

options.name: step_cli_executable
options.description: Name (or absolute path) of the C(step-cli) executable to use

options.name: token
options.description: The one-time token used to authenticate with the CA in order to revoke the certificate.
